COLUMNS in EVERY row: 1 front three-quarter toward screen LOWER RIGHT; 2 true back three-quarter toward UPPER RIGHT, back clearly shown; 3 true back three-quarter toward UPPER LEFT; 4 front three-quarter toward LOWER LEFT.
ROWS: 1 standing ready; 2 left-foot-forward walking; 3 visibly opposite right-foot-forward walking; 4 the specified attack directed along that column's facing. No text, labels, frames, lines, floor, scenery, ground shadows, background colour, checkerboard, bloom or baked ambient glow. True alpha-zero empty background. The game supplies ground shadows.
Primary priority: match the approved softly painted heroes while maintaining this unit's distinctive silhouette and readable palette at small battlefield size.
NAMED ACTOR: 척후병 (scout). In image 1 choose ONLY row 1, column 3, counted from top left.
